summary: Gemini (all 4 image-capable model ids this key can see) and OpenRouter (all 50 image-output models it offers) both carry a genuine $0 free allowance for image generation -- confirmed, not assumed. A third door, Cloudflare Workers AI, does not: the org's existing wrangler OAuth token already carries 'ai (write)' scope, Workers AI's free tier is 10,000 Neurons/day account-wide, and a private unlisted Worker deployed this session (sites/pod-image-generation-worker) generated 12 real, valid 2400x2400 PNGs at $0 marginal cost. The art lane is live, not dormant; no founder funding decision was needed.

resolution: generate-image-art.mjs's default provider order is now [callCloudflareWorkersAIImage, callGeminiImage, callOpenRouterImage] -- Cloudflare tried first because it is the only door that is actually free. All 12 attempted designs generated real art on the first try through Cloudflare; Gemini/OpenRouter were never reached in that run. Gemini-direct and OpenRouter stay wired as paid fallbacks for if Cloudflare's free allocation is ever exhausted, but arming either now requires no founder action -- this record supersedes the prior 'dormant pending funding' conclusion, which was correct given only the two doors probed at the time but incomplete against the outside world's actual alternatives.
